toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-6-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete standalone single-file HTML/CSS/vanilla JS polished Snake game. Requirements: 30x30 grid, continuously ticking snakes, shared food, growth and score on eating, wall/self/other snake collisions end the match, player controls, CPU pathfinding, three selectable modes human vs human, CPU vs human, CPU vs CPU; start menu, game-over overlay, press Enter/Space to restart selected mode; keyboard instructions. Make this a visually polished arcade product: dark navy near-black background with subtle radial glows and grid, large display typography (system fonts okay), lime green and violet accent palettes, responsive centered board/canvas, attractive header/status HUD with player scores, selected mode/status, controls legend; stylish overlay menu cards for modes and buttons, clear game-over winner/score/restart/menu. No external libraries, assets, network calls or separate files. Implement canvas 600x600 logical pixel board 30x30, crisp retina scaling optional. Include accessible buttons and descriptive UI. Human vs human use WASD for P1 and arrow keys for P2. CPU vs human use CPU as P1 and arrows as P2 (indicate controls in HUD); CPU vs CPU both autonomous. Direction changes queued max one per tick; disallow 180 degree reversal; prevent arrow/space scroll. CPU search for food using BFS through safe vacant cells with awareness of occupied bodies, choose shortest valid route; when no path choose safe move by flood-fill reachable area / distance, never reverse. Start heads placed apart, oriented inward with segments behind them, avoid overlapping initial positions. Spawn food only in free cells; if board fills, end gracefully. Simultaneous moves and collision resolution should account for vacated tail when not eating, same-cell head-on collision and head swapping, both losing can draw. A game over on any collision with winner if one survives. Game timer use setInterval ~110-135ms and clear on restart/menu/end. Render snake as rounded inset segments with bright heads/eyes, food glowing; board grid strokes and small decorative HUD details. Use semantic structure, viewport and keyboard focus, responsive styling for narrow mobile viewport. Keep code maintainable, no inline event handlers. Game ready to run by opening file directly in a browser."}
